# The BW light: M850D3 + ACL25416U-B imaged onto the plate (generated by analysis/monitoring/optics/bw_light.py)

- Asphere vertex 22.4 mm out along the sight line from the port centre; tube front 29.5 mm; die 8.17 mm behind S2 (paraxial 8.92), 44.5 mm out; image 192 mm from the lens, magnification 10.9.
- Camera: working distance 176 mm, 25.3 um/px, ROI 640 x 96 px = 16.2 x 10.9 mm on the bed.

## Eye safety (IEC 62471 / 2006/25/EC exposure limits)

R(λ)-weighted share of the LED's light 0.492; luminance of the lit aperture ~124 cd/m² (CIE V(λ) tail, rough); apparent source at the image 0.119 rad.

| case | L_R weighted (W/m²/sr) | E_IR (W/m²) | by E_IR | by L_IR |
|---|---:|---:|---|---|
| bare LED at 200 mm (Thorlabs: RG0) | 36,804 (0.011 rad FOV) | 9.0 | exempt | exempt to RG2 |
| in the beam at its image: CW 1.5 A | 208,284 | 4,273 (7 mm: 3,269) | RG3 | RG3 |
| in the beam at its image: 2.0 A pulses at 60 % duty (24 kfps, 20 us), time-averaged | 159,590 | 3,274 (7 mm: 2,504) | RG3 | RG3 |
| in the beam at its image: 2.0 A pulses at 36 % duty (24 kfps, 10 us), time-averaged | 95,754 | 1,965 (7 mm: 1,503) | RG2 | RG3 |
| bare plate's specular reflection through the open chamber door (CW 1.5 A, R 0.85) | 160,099 | 466 | RG1 | RG3 |

Open chamber door, bare plate: 44% of the light on the bed leaves through the door (mean exit [98.9, -95.0, 25.5]); at the guard's front 0% reaches the viewing window, 94% the fixed panel (x 254 to 316), 6% elsewhere. Below the L_IR limit at <= 0.85 A CW.

Window reflection: 0.034 W per W, 46% onto the recoater sensor post, 54% to the guard's back panel (opaque) near [-3.6, 215.0, 1.1], ~252 W/m² there at 2 A.
Brightest diffuse surface (the lit bed), R-weighted: 81 W/m²/sr.

Limits used: L_IR_weak_stimulus_t_gt_10s 60,000, L_R_10s 281,171, E_IR_1000s 101, E_IR_100s 569, E_IR_10s 3,201
